def transform(grid):
    cols = list(range(1, len(grid[0]), 3))
    order = sorted(range(len(cols)), key=lambda i: -sum(row[cols[i]] == 0 for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for dst, src in enumerate(order):
            out[r][cols[dst]] = row[cols[src]]
    return out
